name: interactive-blur-reveal
title: Interactive Blur Reveal
description: WebGL2 fullscreen shader that keeps the image frosted/blurred by default and reveals a sharp, clear version wherever the cursor trails. Uses a fluid mouse-trail mask with animated film grain and a subtle vignette.

changelog.summary: Documented the lack of a reduced-motion fallback and reworked the remixer controls.

props.name: mouseRadius
props.description: Radius of the cursor reveal mask in canvas pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Trail persistence and fade duration in seconds.
